title: What Is Counted across a Guest's Hotel Reservations, and What Is Not
content:
Where a guest holds several Hotel Rate Plans reservations that overlap in dates, the rate plans are not combined: each reservation is priced, taxed and penalised entirely on its own terms.

**The one figure that is aggregated.** The only figure aggregated across reservations is the guest's own room-night history, which decides whether the repeat-cancellation review is triggered and whether a goodwill gesture is within the desk's authority.

**The review threshold.** A guest whose cancellations in the last twelve months exceed 4 is referred to the property desk before any further discretionary concession is given.

**What is counted per room.** Occupancy limits, extra-occupant charges and cot or rollaway charges are counted per room and never across the portfolio.

**Discounts and negotiated rates.** Club discounts and corporate rates are likewise applied reservation by reservation, and a discount earned on one reservation is never spread across another.

## Counted across the portfolio, or not

| Figure | Counted across the guest's reservations |
| --- | --- |
| Cancellations in the last twelve months | yes |
| Room nights in the last twelve months | yes |
| Occupancy limits | no — per room |
| Extra-occupant charges | no — per room |
| Cot and rollaway charges | no — per room |
| Club discounts and corporate rates | no — reservation by reservation |

## Boundary cases on the review threshold

A guest with 4 cancellations in the last twelve months does not exceed 4, and no referral to the property desk arises on that ground. A guest with 5 does exceed it, and a further discretionary concession goes to the property desk first.
